title: eriochloa procera
intro: Eriochloa procera, commonly known as Bambangan, is a type of grass native to Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands, belonging to the family Poaceae. The plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-diabetic agent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may help in managing conditions such as diabetes and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Eriochloa procera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
